# CANDIDATE: ORB_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A strong up-volume bias within the opening range predicts follow-through buying when the ORB high is subsequently broken on elevated volume. This captures institutional accumulation during the open that manifests as a breakout with volume confirmation, exploiting the tendency for strong opening range imbalances to persist through the mid-morning session.

## Mechanism

Define ORB as the first 30 minutes (09:30-10:00). Sum volume of up-bars (close>open) and down-bars (close<open) inside the ORB. If up_volume/down_volume > 1.5 AND price breaks above ORB_high on a bar with volume > 1.3 * average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter long at the close of the breakout bar. Exit shape: Stop at ORB_low (chart-stop), TP1 at 2R, runner trailed using a chandelier exit (ATR20 * 2.5). Regime hint: Effective when VIX < 22, time 10:00-11:30, and the 5-minute VWAP slope is flat (|slope| < 0.05% per bar). Avoid days where VIX rises >0.5 points from the open.
